# xfo-miner v1.0.6

This release promotes the latest GPU identity payload and VRAM reporting improvements into the formal miner release baseline.

## Highlights

- Added `vram_gb` to the GPU identity payload sent during pool login so downstream runtime can see each reported device's memory capacity directly in the authoritative device envelope.
- Improved OpenCL fallback GPU scanning so Linux environments without `nvidia-smi` can recover VRAM from `clinfo` output instead of defaulting to zero memory.
- Tightened scheduler-side GPU identity preparation with explicit logging around prepared stable device identities before login.

## Scope

### GPU identity payload enrichment

- `internal/pool/protocol.go` extends `GPUIdentity` with `vram_gb`.
- `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go` now forwards per-device VRAM into the login device payload.
- This lets pool-side consumers receive stable GPU identity data together with memory size in the same handshake contract.

### OpenCL VRAM recovery improvements

- `internal/telemetry/gpu.go` now parses OpenCL `Global memory size` fields and converts raw bytes into `VRAMGB`.
- When `nvidia-smi` is unavailable and the miner falls back to OpenCL identity discovery, device memory is now preserved instead of being reported as zero.
- The OpenCL identity source string is normalized to `opencl_uuid_khr` across platforms for a cleaner cross-platform contract.

### Verification hardening

- Added regression coverage for `clinfo` memory parsing formats in `internal/telemetry/gpu_test.go`.
- Scheduler login-device preparation now emits an informational log with the prepared stable GPU device count for easier operator inspection.

## Why this release matters

- Prevents under-reporting GPU memory on OpenCL-based discovery paths.
- Makes miner-to-pool GPU inventory data richer and more consistent for downstream scheduling and telemetry consumers.
- Establishes a cleaner device identity contract ahead of further pool-side GPU capability usage.

## Validation

- Verified with:
  - `go test ./...`
  - `go build ./cmd/xfo-miner`
  - `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go test -exec /bin/true ./...`
  - `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./cmd/xfo-miner`

## Operator notes

- This release does not change operator configuration surface.
- The visible functional change is improved GPU metadata reporting, especially on hosts relying on OpenCL-based probing paths.
